subject.title: Cron session accumulation can silently exhaust agent context window — no guardrails or warnings

question: Should this umbrella stay open until maintainers resolve both guarded cron base-session retention and user-facing cron/context guardrails, or should it be narrowed to the canonical retention issue?
rationale: The source-level retention bug is clear, but the permanent behavior spans compatibility-sensitive session preservation plus new warning policy for cron cadence and context pressure.

options.title: Keep Umbrella For Coordinated Decision
options.body: Track the guarded retention fix plus cadence/context warning policy here until maintainers choose the final behavior.

options.title: Narrow To Retention Only
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89666 as canonical for retention and split cadence/context warnings into a separate product issue.

options.title: Defer Core Guardrails
options.body: Fix only the session cleanup bug now and leave high-frequency cadence guidance to docs or operator practice unless new evidence justifies core warnings.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella For Coordinated Decision
recommendation.body: Track the guarded retention fix plus cadence/context warning policy here until maintainers choose the final behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest merged-history signal around the cron retention and session maintenance contract that needs the policy decision.
